senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Zif, in the territory of Judah.—Denom. זִיפִי, pl. זִיפִים, זִיפִין inhabitants of Zif.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 48b:18">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>דבש זיפים</he>, v. <cite ref="G00393">preced.</cite>) <he>על שם מקומו</he> the honey of the Ziphites.—
Ib. (ref. to Ps. LIV, 2) ע״ש מקומן Zifim means men of Zif (Josh. XV, 24).
